'''Piij''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] who lived during the [[war against Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] he resided on [[Zakuul]], the capital world of the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Piij appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as a vendor for the "Eternal Championship".
